prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, top bun deep burgundy hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut micro swimsuit of glossy white patent vinyl, made of two small triangle cups held by thin halter strings behind her neck and back, joined to the bottom by two thin vertical straps of the same vinyl about two fingers apart that run down on either side of her navel from the lower corners of the cups to the top corners of the bottom, linked by three small horizontal straps with polished silver buckles stacked down the center of her stomach, her waist sides, her flanks and the skin between and around the straps bare, the bottom is only a small triangle at the front cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her hips, thighs and legs completely bare, the vinyl shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her arms bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small beauty mark beside her navel and a small mole near her collarbone. The materials show real behaviour: the polished silver buckles catching small bright highlights, the glossy vinyl molded so closely that it shows the dip of her navel, her ribs and her hip bones, a wet-looking sheen sliding over each contour. Pose: one hand sweeping her hair back, the other resting on her hip, one leg crossed in front to show the boot — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy white leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy white lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip.

Background: a classical Chinese garden with a stone path, a zigzag bridge with a waist-high rail, a moon gate of standard height and a pavilion, in warm golden late-afternoon light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
